title: Disney Plus to Launch Over 60 3D Movies on Meta Quest App
summary: Disney Plus to launch over 60 3D movies on Meta Quest app
detailed: A sneak peek of the immersive experience was provided during a trial of Meta’s upcoming VR Glasses, which are anticipated to launch in spring 2027.

The experience was described as engaging, but as some observers noted, it remains to be seen whether the novelty of watching a full-length movie in such an environment will sustain its allure over time.

With this move, Disney is looking to capitalize on the growing interest in virtual reality entertainment, creating a unique platform that could redefine how audiences engage with movies in a more interactive and immersive setting.
